nodes.summary: For a topological group $G$, the generator rank $d(G)$ is the least natural number $k$ such that some finite subset $S \subseteq G$ with $k$ elements generates a dense subgroup of $G$. If no finite subset of $G$ generates a dense subgroup, then $d(G) = 0$ by convention.
nodes.title: Generator rank of a topological group

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and a topological group $G$, this is the statement that the continuous cohomology group $H^2(G, \mathbb{F}_p)$ of degree $2$, with coefficients in the trivial representation of $G$ on $\mathbb{F}_p$, is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb{F}_p$.
nodes.title: Finite-dimensional second cohomology mod $p$

nodes.summary: Let $M/F$ be an extension of number fields, with rings of integers $\mathcal{O}_F$ and $\mathcal{O}_M$. Then $M/F$ is everywhere unramified when every prime ideal $\mathfrak{P}$ of $\mathcal{O}_M$ lying over a nonzero prime ideal $\mathfrak{p}$ of $\mathcal{O}_F$ has ramification index $1$ over $\mathcal{O}_F$, and every infinite place of $M$ lying over a real place of $F$ is real.
nodes.title: Everywhere unramified extension

nodes.summary: For a number field $F$ and a prime $p$, this is the group $\mathrm{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{un},p}/F)$ of field automorphisms of the maximal unramified pro-$p$ extension $F^{\mathrm{un},p}$ of $F$ that fix $F$, under composition and with the Krull topology.
nodes.title: Galois group of the maximal unramified pro-$p$ extension

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a number field, $\overline{F}$ an algebraic closure of $F$, and $p$ a prime. The maximal unramified pro-$p$ extension $F^{\mathrm{un},p}$ of $F$ is the compositum in $\overline{F}$ of all intermediate fields $F \subseteq M \subseteq \overline{F}$ such that $M/F$ is finite, Galois and everywhere unramified, and its Galois group $\mathrm{Gal}(M/F)$ is a $p$-group (each such $M$ is a number field).
nodes.title: Maximal unramified pro-$p$ extension

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and a topological group $G$, the relation rank $r(G)$ is the dimension over $\mathbb{F}_p$ of the continuous cohomology group $H^2(G, \mathbb{F}_p)$ of degree $2$, with coefficients in the trivial representation of $G$ on $\mathbb{F}_p$. If this space is infinite-dimensional, then $r(G) = 0$ by convention.
nodes.title: Relation rank of a topological group

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a number field, let $p$ be an odd prime, and let $G = \mathrm{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{un},p}/F)$ be the Galois group of the maximal unramified pro-$p$ extension of $F$. Write $d(G)$ for the generator rank and $r(G)$ for the relation rank of $G$, $r_1$ and $r_2$ for the numbers of real and complex places of $F$, and $\delta$ for $1$ if $F$ contains a primitive $p$-th root of unity and $0$ otherwise. nodes.title: Shafarevich's relation-rank bound

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$ and a topological group $G$, this is $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ with the discrete topology, regarded as a continuous representation of $G$ over $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ on which every element of $G$ acts as the identity.
nodes.title: Trivial representation on $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
